bio.text: José Luis Solache, Jr. was first elected to the California State Assembly in November 2024, representing Lakewood, Lynwood, Maywood, Paramount, South Gate, Huntington Park, Bellflower and Walnut Park.
His official biography says he has served as mayor, mayor pro tem and councilmember of Lynwood since 2013, and earlier served three terms on the Lynwood Unified School District board.
Solache was born in Bellflower, grew up in Lynwood, and earned a B.A. in liberal studies from California State University, Dominguez Hills.
